- Risk: sets concession bar — propose gating mechanism: this package is available to TechPorta only and requires procurement sign-off and legal countersign on SLA addendum.

Timeline: need yes/no by end of day Mon 6/14 to meet customer renewal window and send DocuSign Monday evening. Attachments: detailed retention analysis, SOW redlines, draft SLA addendum.
